modrinth.name: 3.0.0 · forge · 1.20.1
modrinth.changelog:
## [3.0.0] - 2026-10-23

JAUML grows from a JSON config library into the common library for NightBeam mods. Every 2.x API is kept with
unchanged signatures; mods built against 2.x keep working.

### Added
- **Typed configs** (`tn.naizo.jauml.config`): `JaumlConfig.bind(subdir, name, MyConfig.class)` binds a plain Java class to a JSON file. `@Comment` text and `@Range` bounds are written as `//` comment lines, comments are accepted when reading, missing keys get defaults, wrong types are coerced, out-of-range values are clamped, and change listeners, `update`, `reload`/`reloadIfChanged` and `JsonMigrator` migrations are supported.
- **Platform facade** (`tn.naizo.jauml.platform`): `Platform` (loader, physical side, game and config directories, Minecraft version, mod versions with range checks) and `Services.load` for a mod's own `META-INF/services` implementations. Replaces the per-mod MultiLoader `Services`/`IPlatformHelper` copy.
- **Server events and scheduler** (`tn.naizo.jauml.server`): `ServerEvents` (starting, started, stopping, stopped, tick start/end, `currentServer()`), `PlayerEvents` (join, leave) and `Scheduler` (`runLater`, `runRepeating`, `queueServerWork`), fired from Fabric API, NeoForge and Forge events.
- **`Event<T>`** (`tn.naizo.jauml.event`): a small prioritized listener list for mods' own events.
- **Utilities**: `Version`/`VersionRange` (Maven ranges, comparators, `~`/`^`, wildcards) and `Cooldowns` (per-key cooldowns on any clock).
- **`PlatformProvider`** default methods: `getGameDirectory`, `isPhysicalClient`, `getModVersion`, `getModName`, `getLoadedModIds`, `getMinecraftVersion`.
- Root Gradle build (`./gradlew buildAll`, `testAll`, `cleanAll`, `syncVersion -PmodVersion=x.y.z`) and a CI workflow that tests and builds every workspace.
- `-Djauml.selfTest=true` boot check that logs every server event and a scheduler run, plus GameTest server runs (`runGameTestServer`, `runGametest`) in the 26.x loader modules and 1.20.1 Forge to use it without a EULA prompt.

### Changed
- **Supported Minecraft versions: 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 26.2 and 26.3.** The 1.21.11 and 26.1.2 workspaces are removed.
- Each jar declares only its own Minecraft version (`[26.2,26.3)`, `[26.3,26.4)` instead of `[26.x,27)`).
- On Fabric, JAUML recommends Fabric API; without it configs still work and server events stay idle with a warning.
- Fabric 1.20.1 now needs Fabric Loader 0.16.10 or newer (the minimum of current Fabric API 0.92.12).
- `JaumlConfig.isCompatible` accepts 2.x requirements (`API_BASELINE_MAJOR = 2`).
- `JaumlConfigLib` stays deprecated but is no longer marked for removal; its signatures are pinned by a test.
- `Constants.MOD_VERSION` reads `JaumlConfig.LIBRARY_VERSION`, and a test fails if it drifts from `gradle.properties`.
- Platform providers are loaded once and shared (`PlatformUtil`, `JaumlInitializer` and `JaumlConfig` no longer each scan `ServiceLoader`).
- Loader entrypoints no longer log template "Hello world" messages.
- **Toolchains**: 26.2 and 26.3 on Gradle 9.8.1, Fabric Loom 1.19.3 and ModDevGradle 2.0.148; Fabric API 0.165.0+26.3 / 0.161.0+26.2 / 0.116.17+1.21.1 / 0.92.12+1.20.1; NeoForge 26.3.0.95 (stable) / 26.2.0.93 / 21.1.264; Forge 47.4.28; Parchment 2024.11.17 for 1.21.1; Fabric Loom 1.10.5 for 1.21.1.

### Removed
- Minecraft 1.21.11 and 26.1.2 builds (use JAUML 2.3.1 on those versions).

LUMINOUS: MONSTERS V1.3.0 Changelog

(V1.3.1 HOTFIX)

-Fixed a texture mapping issue on the Icy Zombie
-Fixed a bug that caused the Miner Skeleton and Zombie variants to spawn in other dimensions

--------------------------------------------------------------------
BUG FIXES:
- Fixed an issue where Skeletons would not lower their arms after losing their target
- Fixed an issue where Zombie and Skeleton variants could not wear armor
- Fixed an issue where Zombie and Skeleton variants could not hold items
- Fixed an issue where Zombie and Skeleton variants could not show riding animations
- Fixed an issue where Baby Zombies of all variant types would instantly despawn
- Fixed a bug where Cherry Zombies and Skeletons were spawning in cave biomes
- Fixed an issue that caused the Cherry Zombies and Skeletons to drop no loot

--------------------------------------------------------------------
RETEXTURES / MODEL CHANGES:

-All Custom Skeleton Models no longer have the bow built into their model - they have actual handheld bows, that show draw animations!
- Updated the texture/model of the Icy Zombie (previously the Glacial Zombie)
- Updated the texture/model of the Icy Skeleton (Previously the Glacial Skeleton)
- Updated the texture of the Swamp Skeleton
- Updated the texture of the Dark Oak Zombie
- Updated the texture of the Savanna Zombie
- Updated the texture of the Cherry Zombie
- Updated the texture of the Crimson Walker

-------------------------------------------------------------------
TECHNICAL CHANGES:

- The ID / in game name of the Hollow has changed to "Hollow Skeleton"
- The ID / in game name of the Sunken has changed to "Sunken Skeleton"
- The ID / in game name of the Glacial Zombie has changed to "Icy Zombie"
- The ID / in game name of the Glacial Skeleton has changed to "Icy Skeleton"
- The ID / in game name of the Revenant has changed to "Revenant Skeleton"
- When A crimson walker "bursts", it will now apply the Hemorrhage effect to ALL nearby entitles, not just players
- Crimson Walkers are now completely immune to thee Hemorrhage effect
- Revenants will now heal for half as much when hitting a players shield
- Miner Zombies will now spawn with a random pickaxe (stone, iron and gold) with a 70% chance

-------------------------------------------------------------------
NEW FEATURES:

- A Complete Mob Overhaul: Rebuilt all mobs from the ground up to function as exact mechanical copies of vanilla zombies and skeletons. This major structural update removes the GeckoLib dependency, ensuring all entities look, move, and interact seamlessly with the base game.

- Native Vanilla Support: All Zombie and Skeleton variants now natively support:
- Vanilla animations (attack, aggro, walk, and bow drawing) instead of blockbench recreations.
- Inertia-based movement (e.g., limb flailing when attacked).
- Rendered armor and dynamically held items.
- Proper sitting and riding animations in boats, minecarts, and on mounts.
- Baby variants for all custom zombies.

- Vanilla Loot table Parity: Loot tables now perfectly replicate vanilla behavior and fully support the Looting enchantment, with the following custom tweaks:

- Icy Variants: Rare chance to drop snowballs.
- Miner Variants: Slightly higher chance than standard zombies to drop iron ingots.
- Dark Oak Variants: Drop red and brown mushrooms instead of potatoes and carrots.
- Crimson Walkers: Occasionally drop nether wart.
- Sunken Skeletons: Very rare chance to drop a nautilus shell.

- Dynamic Biome Integration: Added biome tag compatibility for custom biomes using common forge, c, and minecraft namespaces (e.g., spawn Icy variants in #forge:is_snowy or Swamp variants in #c:is_swamp), greatly improving compatibility in large modpacks.


- Server-Based Configurations: Migrated configuration files to be server-based and per-world to improve reliability. Settings are now located in each world save's serverconfig folder under LuminousMonstersConfig.toml.

New Configuration Categories:

- Attack Effects: Toggle frost_effect, slowness_effect, poison_effect, hunger_effect, and lifesteal_effect.

- Effect Multipliers: Adjust the duration and scale of these effects via frost_duration, slowness_duration, poison_duration, hunger_duration, and lifesteal_amount.

- New Entity Tags: Added data pack tags to assign on-hit effects to custom mobs: #luminous_monsters:causes_frost, :causes_slowness, :causes_poison, :causes_hunger, and :steals_life. Also added #luminous_monsters:immune_to_hemmorhage (currently only containing Crimson Walkers).

-------------------------------------------------------------------
BUG FIXES:

- Fixed an issue where Skeletons would fail to lower their arms after losing their target.
- Fixed a bug preventing Zombie and Skeleton variants from wearing armor, holding items, or displaying riding animations.
- Fixed Baby Zombies of all variant types instantly despawning.
- Fixed Cherry Zombies and Skeletons spawning in cave biomes and dropping no loot.

-------------------------------------------------------------------
RETEXTURES & MODEL CHANGES

- Removed built-in bows from custom skeleton models; they now use standard handheld bows with proper draw animations.
- Updated textures and models for the Icy Zombie and Icy Skeleton.
- Updated textures for the Swamp Skeleton, Dark Oak Zombie, Savanna Zombie, Cherry Zombie, and Crimson Walker.

-------------------------------------------------------------------
TECHNICAL CHANGES

- The ID / in game name of the Hollow has changed to "Hollow Skeleton"
- The ID / in game name of the Sunken has changed to "Sunken Skeleton"
- The ID / in game name of the Glacial Zombie has changed to "Icy Zombie"
- The ID / in game name of the Glacial Skeleton has changed to "Icy Skeleton"
- The ID / in game name of the Revenant has changed to "Revenant Skeleton"

- Crimson Walkers are now completely immune to the Hemorrhage effect.
- Revenants now heal for half their normal amount when hitting a player's shield.
- Miner Zombies now spawn with a 70% chance to hold a random pickaxe (stone, iron, or gold).

# RPG Attribute System 5.1.2

## Fixes

### `use_vanilla_xp` gave no VP at all on Fabric

With `use_vanilla_xp` set to `true` in `config/ras/settings.json`, mob kills stop paying RAS's own VP and pay the XP
the mob drops instead. Forge and NeoForge did this, but the Fabric builds never had the vanilla-XP side, so on
Fabric (every version) players with the setting on earned no VP at all. Fabric now pays a kill the XP the mob
drops, the same as the other loaders, and shows `+N VP` in the action bar when `show_vp_inaction_bar` is on.

Only XP from kills counts, on every loader. XP that other mods hand out for mining, building or crafting is not
converted.

## Changes

### Turn an attribute off completely: `"enabled": false`

Each attribute file in `config/ras/attributes/` has a new `enabled` setting (default `true`; existing files get it on
the next start). With `"enabled": false` the attribute is gone from the game: it isn't sent to players, isn't shown in
any menu, can't take points and its commands never run. Before, the only option was `"lock": true`, which still shows
the attribute greyed out as locked, and deleted attribute files were recreated on the next start.

Points a player already spent in an attribute keep their effect after it's turned off, so turn attributes off before
players start, or reset their stats.

No save changes.

## Note

This change log includes the summarized changes. For the full changelog, please go to

### 11.1.0

- Added bonus drops for nine more mobs, such as skeletons, spiders, creepers and wither skeletons.

### 11.0.0

- Fixed #225 by giving cold and warm chickens their own cards and blue or brown eggs.
- Fixed British Shorthair cats using the calico card instead of their own card.
- Fixed a crash when other mods list mob farm tooltips in the background.
- Fixed shift-clicking a stack of cards into the card binder putting all of them into one slot.
- Fixed locked output slots of the farm screen not matching the selected theme.
- Fixed Ice and Fire dragon loot causing log errors when Ice and Fire is not installed.
- Fixed fishing on Fabric dropping cards for a different catch than the one actually reeled in.
- Fixed modded fish without a matching mob dropping a pig card when fishing.
- Fixed chicken capture cards not stacking; existing ones are cleaned up once on load.
- Changed all mob capture cards to a reworked card design.
- Changed the blank, creative and default rarity cards to match the reworked card design.
- Changed the "Steampunk" progress gauge to a steadier pointer with even steps.
- Changed Ice and Fire dragon farms to roll bones, flesh, scales and blood separately each cycle.
- Added support for "Vanilla Backport", which unlocks the new chicken and Armadillo cards.
- Added an Armadillo card and Armadillo scutes as a Desert Farm bonus drop.

### 10.13.0

- Fixed #178 by removing per-mob data from capture cards so identical mobs stack again.
- Fixed #155 by adding three redstone modes to mob farms, switchable in the farm screen.
- Fixed #115 by showing when a mob needs a sword enhancement and which farm gives bonus drops.
- Fixed #208 and #168 by adding a JEI category that reuses the farm's own loot preview.
- Fixed buffered items being duplicated on partial insert and lost on reload or when broken.
- Fixed storage mods getting stuck and never pulling results out of a farm again.
- Changed existing capture cards to be cleaned up once on load so they stack with new cards.
- Changed powered farms to stay disabled by default, matching the previous redstone behavior.
- Changed loot previews to be cached for a day and filled in the background for JEI.
- Changed the top side of a farm to no longer hand out results to automation.
- Changed the default farm screen theme to "Technology"; the old look is now the "Technical" theme.
- Changed the farm screen info icon to the farm's block and the loot preview icon to a bag.

- Added six new farm screen themes, selectable in the new client configuration.
- Added rotating faded example items to the empty mob, enhancement, filter and upgrade slots.

### 10.12.0

- Fixed crashes and load failures caused by broken data in farms, cards and the configuration.
- Fixed farms starting to work when an empty capture item was inserted.
- Fixed log spam from empty capture items and from mobs that could not be rendered or looted.
- Fixed cards for mobs from uninstalled mods showing up as a pig instead of being rejected.
- Fixed mob capture cards always dropping when their drop chance was set to 0.

- Changed colored mob capture cards to a new, stable card number that differs from before.
- Changed Wither farms to drop at most one Nether Star and Wither Rose per cycle again.
